results.title: Two brand-new warehouses in under a year, no stated monitoring standard set from day one
results.closest_fact_claim: In under a year, Zomato Hyperpure leased more than 5 lakh sq ft of warehousing across two sites in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region: 2.5 lakh sq ft in Bhiwandi (5-year lease signed August 2025, ~Rs 66.21 lakh/month rent from March 2026) and 2.53 lakh sq ft in Palava (5-year lease from February 15, 2025, ~Rs 85.3 lakh/month), both with 5% annual rent escalation.

results.title: Meat and seafood distribution through brand-new sites with no named cold-chain monitoring system
results.closest_fact_claim: The Bhiwandi warehouse will support Hyperpure's sourcing and distribution of fresh and packaged products -- fruits, vegetables, meat, seafood, groceries, and essentials -- for hotels, restaurants, caterers, and food businesses.
